name: Shatha Ladies Salon (ഷതാ ലേഡീസ് സലൂൺ)
address: Near Naumiyah Tower, Beside Al Wasl Bakery - Waha street - Al Nuaimia 1 - Ajman - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Shatha Ladies Salon is your go-to destination for beauty and self-care, proudly known as the Best Ladies Salon in Ajman. We offer a wide range of professional services including haircuts, hair styling, coloring, keratin treatments, facials, waxing, threading, manicures, pedicures, and bridal makeovers.
If you’re searching for a ladies salon near you, Shatha Ladies Salon provides a relaxing and hygienic environment with experienced staff dedicated to enhancing your natural beauty. We use high-quality products and the latest techniques to ensure every client leaves feeling confident and refreshed.
Visit us today and experience top-quality beauty services in the heart of Ajman!

reviews.author: AMEER
reviews.text:
My friend's sister got a hair Botox treatment and hair extensions done at this salon last May. We paid a total of AED 1,250, which included the treatment and the shampoo and hair mask that the salon recommended to maintain the results.

Unfortunately, the hair Botox treatment didn't even last two months, despite using the recommended products exactly as advised.

When we contacted the salon about the issue, they asked us to come in. Instead of taking responsibility, they said they would need to remove the hair extensions, redo the Botox treatment, and then reattach the extensions—but they wanted to charge an additional AED 125.

The owner was very rude, and the staff were not helpful. They kept insisting that no one had ever complained about their service. However, after reading the reviews here, I realized that other customers have reported similar experiences. I only wish I had checked the reviews before choosing this salon.

Mistakes can happen in any business, but what matters is how they respond. Unfortunately, instead of providing a fair solution after an expensive treatment failed so quickly, they asked us to pay more. Based on this experience, I would not recommend getting a hair Botox treatment here.

We’re sorry to hear about your feedback. However, we are unable to find any record matching your review. Could you please let us know when you visited our salon and whether it was our Sharjah or Ajman branch?

If you had any concerns, we would have truly appreciated the opportunity to address them directly. We always encourage our customers to contact us so we can resolve issues promptly.
